## Purpose and executable topology
VictoriaMetrics is a Go time-series database and monitoring stack. It runs either as a single binary that combines ingestion, query, and persistence, or as a horizontally scalable cluster split into insert, select, and storage services. Primary entry points are `app/victoria-metrics/main.go`, `app/vminsert/main.go`, `app/vmselect/main.go`, and `app/vmstorage/main.go`.

## Single-node and cluster boundary
The single-node process exposes the integrated deployment path and reuses the same functional domains as the cluster. In cluster mode, `vminsert` accepts and normalizes writes, `vmstorage` owns durable partitions and indexing, and `vmselect` executes distributed reads against storage nodes. RPC contracts are centralized in `lib/vminsertapi/api.go` and `lib/vmselectapi/server.go`; the storage engine is in `lib/storage/storage.go` and `lib/storage/partition.go`.

## Ingestion pipeline
HTTP and socket-facing handlers accept Prometheus remote write/import plus Graphite, Influx, OpenTSDB, OpenTelemetry, DataDog, New Relic, CSV, native, and Zabbix formats. Cluster handlers are rooted in `app/vminsert/main.go`, with protocol adapters such as `app/vminsert/promremotewrite/request_handler.go` and `app/vminsert/opentelemetry/request_handler.go`. Parsing is separated into reusable streaming parsers under `lib/protoparser/`, e.g. `lib/protoparser/promremotewrite/stream/streamparser.go`.

Normalized series pass through label processing and optional stream aggregation before being written or routed. Important write-path controls include `app/vminsert/relabel/relabel.go`, `app/vminsert/common/streamaggr.go`, and `lib/streamaggr/streamaggr.go`.

## Agent-based collection and forwarding
`vmagent` is a separate collector/forwarder entry point at `app/vmagent/main.go`. It can scrape Prometheus targets through `lib/promscrape/scraper.go`, including service-discovery providers under `lib/promscrape/discovery/`, and it also accepts many push protocols through adapters such as `app/vmagent/promremotewrite/request_handler.go`. Its remote-write subsystem batches, relabels, aggregates, and sends to configured destinations; the durable/transport boundary is `app/vmagent/remotewrite/remotewrite.go` and `app/vmagent/remotewrite/client.go`, supported by `lib/persistentqueue/persistentqueue.go`.

## Query serving and evaluation
`vmselect` is the query API boundary at `app/vmselect/main.go`. Prometheus-compatible endpoints are implemented in `app/vmselect/prometheus/prometheus.go`; Graphite requests use `app/vmselect/graphite/render_api.go`. PromQL/MetricsQL parsing, planning, rollups, aggregation, caching, and execution live in `app/vmselect/promql/`, notably `parser.go`, `exec.go`, and `rollup.go`. Query evaluation retrieves matching series and blocks from cluster storage through `app/vmselect/netstorage/netstorage.go`; in single-node mode it reaches the local storage engine.

## Storage engine
The storage layer persists high-cardinality time-series data in partitioned, indexed, mergeable on-disk structures. `lib/storage/storage.go` orchestrates ingest and search; `lib/storage/index_db.go` maps metric names/labels to IDs, while `lib/storage/table.go` and `lib/storage/merge.go` manage immutable parts and compaction. `app/vmstorage/vmstorage.go` wraps this engine for cluster RPC access. Cache, compression, and resource-sensitive primitives are shared through `lib/blockcache/blockcache.go`, `lib/encoding/compress.go`, and `lib/memory/memory.go`.

## Alerting, access, operations, and UI
`vmalert` evaluates configured recording/alerting rules against Prometheus, Graphite, or VictoriaLogs datasources, then emits results via remote write and alerts to Alertmanager-compatible notifiers. Its orchestration is in `app/vmalert/main.go`, `app/vmalert/manager.go`, `app/vmalert/rule/group.go`, and `app/vmalert/notifier/alertmanager.go`.

`vmauth` is an authentication-aware reverse proxy/routing layer (`app/vmauth/main.go`, `app/vmauth/auth_config.go`, `app/vmauth/oidc.go`). Backup/restore use pluggable local, S3, GCS, and Azure remote filesystems via `lib/backup/actions/backup.go`, `lib/backup/s3remote/s3.go`, and `lib/backup/gcsremote/gcs.go`; command entry points are `app/vmbackup/main.go` and `app/vmrestore/main.go`. `vmctl` migrates data from VictoriaMetrics and external systems including Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir, Influx, and OpenTSDB (`app/vmctl/main.go`, `app/vmctl/thanos`, `app/vmctl/mimir`).

A TypeScript/React VMUI client lives at `app/vmui/packages/vmui/src/index.tsx`; embedded static UI assets for `vmselect` are under `app/vmselect/vmui/`. Docker Compose examples provide single-node and cluster infrastructure in `deployment/docker/compose-vm-single.yml` and `deployment/docker/compose-vm-cluster.yml`.
